## Architecture Overview

The Loki datasource `QueryData` method is defined in `grafana/pkg/tsdb/loki/loki.go` as part of the `Service` struct. A standalone wrapper in `grafana/pkg/tsdb/loki/standalone/datasource.go` delegates to it. Changing the signature to add a `stream bool` parameter breaks the `backend.QueryDataHandler` interface implementation and all callers.

## Detailed Analysis

### Primary Implementation

- **`loki.go`** (line 182) — `func (s *Service) QueryData(ctx context.Context, req *backend.QueryDataRequest) (*backend.QueryDataResponse, error)` — Main QueryData implementation. Must change signature.
- **`loki.go`** (line 198) — Internal `queryData()` helper function that implements the actual query logic. Must accept the `stream` parameter.
- **`loki.go`** (line 244) — `executeQuery()` function that executes individual queries. Needs streaming parameter.

### Standalone Datasource

- **`standalone/datasource.go`** (line 30) — `func (d *Datasource) QueryData(...)` — Standalone Loki datasource wrapper implementing `backend.QueryDataHandler`. Must match the interface and forward the new parameter.

### Callers

- **`healthcheck.go`** (line 56) — `resp, err := s.QueryData(ctx, &backend.QueryDataRequest{...})` — Calls QueryData during health checks. Must pass the new `stream` parameter (likely `false`).

### Streaming Support

- **`streaming.go`** — Implements `SubscribeStream()`, `RunStream()`, `PublishStream()` for websocket streaming. Directly related to the `stream` parameter functionality.
- **`streaming_test.go`** — Tests streaming feature behind `flagLokiExperimentalStreaming` toggle.

### Test Files

- **`healthcheck_test.go`** — Tests health check which calls QueryData.
- **`loki_bench_test.go`** (line 22) — Benchmarks query execution path.
- **`api_test.go`** — Tests the underlying data query API mechanisms.

### Supporting Files

- **`api.go`** (line 172) — `LokiAPI.DataQuery()` lower-level function making HTTP requests.
- **`parse_query.go`** (line 128) — `parseQuery()` parses incoming query requests.
